errors.text_span: В секторите са включени етикети с проценти.
errors.evidence: The statement implies that all sectors have percentage labels, but in the figure, only two of the four sectors (the yellow and gray ones) are explicitly labeled with percentages.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от жълтия сектор и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are sorted in descending order of size when moving counter-clockwise from the largest (yellow) sector, not clockwise. Following a clockwise direction from the yellow slice (57.1%), the next slice is the blue one (the smallest), followed by the orange one (the second smallest), and then the gray one (26.2%). This is not a descending order.
